summary: Hourly free-buffer suppressed due to postback tag truncation on scheduled embed job causing retroactive invoice delta
description:
Issue summary:
MindfulAI reports a retroactive billing delta after a scheduled nightly embedding job (daily bulk embed) on 2026-03-09. Several hourly free-buffer credits that normally applied to warmup and microbatching were missing for multiple hourly buckets. The customer sees a +$1,240 provisional charge on the provisional invoice and requests a breakdown and corrective credit.

Impact:
- Customer billed unexpectedly for warmup/idle tokens normally covered by hourly free buffer for 8 hourly buckets on 2026-03-09 US-east run window.
- Customer reported increased MTTI for investigation and requests provisional credit prior to final invoice close.
- Workload runs on Dedicated reserved capacity but falls back to hosted postback attribution for hourly buffer accounting when tag metadata is present.

Environment:
- Dedicated pool -> fallback to hosted postback aggregator in us-east.
- Job: scheduled_batch_embed_2026-03-09-03
- Customer org id: org-MindfulAI-88
- Model: embed-text-1-small

Steps to reproduce / observed sequence:
1) Nightly job executed at 2026-03-09T03:20:10Z.
2) Postbacks for hourly warmup credits were emitted by edge proxy and forwarded to postback-service.
3) Our postback-service stored tag metadata but later trimmed tag field to 128 chars during normalization. Customer uses long pipeline tags (org+dataset+job+region+user-agent) which exceeded the normalized limit.
4) Tag truncation caused the hourly-tag matcher to not find the reserved-hourly buffer bucket and the credits were not applied; metrics show postbacks accepted but unmatched.
5) Provisional invoice shows increased charge; customer alerted billing.

Logs / evidence attached in-ticket:
- Postback trace (excerpts): postback_id=pb_20260309_7b9f, raw_tag="mindfulai:dataset/very-long-name/tenant/flow/…(truncated)", normalized_tag="mindfulai:dataset/very-long-name/tenant/flow/", match_status=NO_MATCH, routing=hosted-agg.us-east-1
- Hourly accumulator query: SELECT * FROM hourly_accumulator WHERE tag_hash IN (...) AND timestamp BETWEEN '2026-03-09T03:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-09T12:00:00Z' -- shows zero credits applied for tag_hashes corresponding to truncated tags.
- Console estimate vs provisional invoice: delta +$1,240.

Expected behavior:
Postback normalization should preserve enough of the identifying prefix so hourly-tag matcher can associate postbacks to the reserved/free-buffer buckets. When truncation occurs, system should fallback to a heuristic match (prefix search) or surface to reconciliation queue rather than drop credits.

Actual behavior:
Normalization truncates tag to 128 chars, matcher performs exact hash lookup and fails, credits are not reconciled. No automatic fallback or ticketing to reconciliation queue was triggered.

Customer request:
- Explanation of root cause and timeline.
- Provisional credit for missing hourly buffer (-$1,240) applied before final invoice.
- Plan for preventing recurrence and confirmation of permanent fix.

investigation_notes: Hypothesis: Tag normalization limit introduced as a safety measure against DB index bloat; recent customer pipeline started producing much longer tags after adding dataset+job+user segment. Evidence: postback traces have accepted payloads with raw_tag lengths 150-190, normalized_tag length 128 and match_status NO_MATCH. Repro: local dev replay with long tags shows same behavior. Query: hourly_accumulator missing entries for truncated hashes. Impact window: 2026-03-09T03:00 -> 2026-03-09T12:00. Suggested fixes: increase stored tag length to 256, add prefix-hash fallback and reconciliation queue, add metric unmatched_postback_rate. Related INT ticket raised for normalization config: INT-2104.
resolution: Temporary: Manual provisional credit of $1,240 applied to INV-2026-03-MA88 and finance notified for memo. Permanent: Postback-service PR #842 increases tag normalization limit to 256 chars, adds prefix-match fallback and reconciliation worker. PR merged 2026-03-12; staged deploy scheduled 2026-03-13 and full deploy 2026-03-14. Added alert unmatched_postback_rate > 0.5% to billing-monitoring. Follow-up: close monitoring window 7 days after full deploy and confirm no further missed credits for MindfulAI. Customer to be offered one-time invoice waiver if reconciliation finds additional missed credits beyond provisional amount.
